card.title: IPhone XR is bootlooping and fails itunes update with error 4013

source.title: IPhone XR is bootlooping and fails itunes update with error 4013

claims.statement: iPhone XR 4013 bootloops are almost always the earpiece flex (liquid on flood illuminator/ALS); unplug all flexes to confirm, and repair rather than replace to keep Face ID.

procedure: Unplug all flexes; test with known-good parts.
Repair or replace the earpiece flex.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
